items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16

ctx.x: Uh, and, and, uh, fella by the name of Johnny Frisco, right, I used to call him Mulefoot Frisco, who played with Schilling's band. Yeah. That was the band. Now they left here, they were on the Orphian circuits, you see, that's when it was a lot of vaudeville. Yeah. And, uh, they went, they left here and they went, uh, and played all around, and they, they, they broke up at, uh, Rockford, Illinois. And, uh, cause she was kinda chiseling on, on the loop. And they had one more week, they went, played, they, they,…
